Results.ReviewText: I have owned my standard Weber for almost 15 years. It is still functional, but I got this new one for my birthday and it is a great upgrade. The grates are even sturdier, I love having the thermometer built in, and I'm considering the pizza stone insert to try something new.
Results.Title: Excellent upgrade

Results.ReviewText: Love it!!! The new add ons featured on this grill are perfect, especially the charcoal boxes. I would for sure give it 5 stars but the kettle itself and the front leg of the grill were dented when I received this shipment. Luckily the dents were not in places that mattered as far as grilling goes. Definite improvement over the original kettle which I owned for several years.
Results.Title: Just Get It

Results.ReviewText: The grill has many amazing features. The few “issues I have are very minor. The ash removal system is good in theory, but it misses a lot of the ash and creates piles of ash inside the grill which is annoying. The fir of the parts during assembly was kind of a pain because the legs were very tight going into their retainers on the bottom of the grill. Overall very satisfied
Results.Title: Very satisfied.

Results.ReviewText: Great grill for couples & small families.  26" better for larger families.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Je ne m’en passerais plus! La

Parfait pour faire du fumoir aussi

Results.ReviewText: I have had webers until a tornado took my two old ones. I bought the spring green Weber with the fancy grate. First the spring green turns poop brown if you put coals on the side. Also the fancy grate is terrible to remove and clean. It catch’s food and the center is a nuisance. I was torn between this grill and a PK for the price. If I had to do it again I’d buy the black 20 inch with the plain grate. It cooks like a Weber.
Results.Title: New Grill 3/22

Results.ReviewText: J’ai acheté le Mastertouch pour remplacer un BBQ d’âge avancé, et il le surpasse nettement

Results.ReviewText: I’ve enjoyed using my Blue Master Touch. The only one thing I wish it had is more weight on the bottom. It is top heavy and the windy days down in south texas keep knocking it over and has sustained a lot of dings and cracked the ceramic in several areas.  I guess I have to keep a full bag of charcoal on the bottom to help add some weight.  Hope it helps.

J’adore le cendrier qui fait en sorte que le charbon ne tombe plus parterre et que la cendre ne part pas au vent lors du nettoyage !!! J’aime aussi le fait que le bbq soit un peu plus haut !! 
Depuis que j’utilise un Weber , mon bbq au propane ne sert plus beaucoup !! Je préfère de loin le charbon !!! 
Si vous n’avez pas déjà fait le saut vers ce mode de cuisson , n’attendez plus !!! C’est Weber qu’il vous faut !!!

Results.ReviewText: I bought this about 6 weeks ago on the advice of many of my friends and I am very glad I did.  The Master-Touch version has great features, especially the lid holder and the hinged grates.  They are great touches and make smoking and grilling so much easier.  I was amazed at how long the grill kept a low temp without having to add charcoal, made smoking ribs a breeze. Grilling on it is just as easy and rewarding, making great steaks and porkchops.  This is really a quality product.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText:
Disappointed.

Initially I was thrilled. The handle and thermometer were upgrades from my previous Weber.

My disappointment lies in the fact that the plastic handle on the vent was constructed of a plastic that melted and ran down the side of the lid and cooled in place, ruining the unit.
I sent an email to customer service and they responded quickly but sent a new handle (the wrong part).
I made them aware of this and have yet to hear of any further action.
Weber has always represented quality. How can you put a plastic part on the lid that can melt?
Results.Title: Disappointed

Results.ReviewText:
I have been wanting to prepare and enjoy more smoked foods. I even thought and inquired about purchasing a drum smoker. Then I ran across a You Tube channel where the individual prepares many smoked dishes on a variety of cookers. However, many of his creations were executed on Weber kettles. This led me to better understand the versatility of the Weber kettle.  And it also had the advantage of a much lower initial cost. 
I have prepared a few dishes - starting with meatloaf and chicken, only to rediscover the great flavor of cooking on charcoal - as opposed to cooking with gas. The kettle has been a welcome addition and a wonderful tool to discover a whole new world smoked foods. I am enjoying the opportunity to try new dishes and experiment with new dishes to try. I am excited to let the adventure into a new cooking experience begin.
Results.Title: Let the adventure begin.

Results.ReviewText: Great grill. Nice color. Provides for most of grilling needs.
Results.Title: Weber Kettle

Results.ReviewText: Bought 1 month ago and last week we used it first time, lamb meat grilled very well, tender, juicy. We really like our news Weber master touch.
Results.Title: I love my Weber kettle grill

Results.ReviewText: Love this Weber grill. You can smoke, grill both direct and indirect, just an all round good grill. It’s well built and makes fantastic meals.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Birthday present for my husband. He loves it! Couldn’t be happier with options
Results.Title: Very satisfied!

Results.ReviewText: My dad had purchased one of these probably 45 years ago.  I also have a Summit S670 and an 18" Smokey Mountain.  Using the Smokey Mountain definitely helped me "master" the Master Touch.  I also really like the ash catch, the multi-function upper grate, and the lid holder
Results.Title: Weber Master Touch

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs.
